name: NEXUS RAG V2 Diagnostic Evaluation Dataset
description: 36 diagnostic test questions across 12 categories grounded in Attention Is All You Need paper for evaluating Dense, BM25, and Hybrid RRF retrieval performance.

test_cases.question: Why does the Transformer avoid recurrence in sequence transduction?
expected_snippets: relying entirely on an attention mechanism

test_cases.question: How do attention mechanisms allow drawing global dependencies?
expected_snippets: draw global dependencies between input and output

test_cases.question: What is the primary architectural difference between recurrent neural networks and the Transformer?
expected_snippets: dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely

test_cases.question: What BLEU score did the big Transformer model achieve on WMT 2014 English-to-German?
What BLEU score was achieved on the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task?
How long was the base model trained on 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs?
expected_snippets: single machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs

test_cases.question: Who is Mitchell P. Marcus?

test_cases.question: What is the purpose of Positional Encoding in the Transformer?
expected_snippets: inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens

test_cases.question: Why does multi-head attention outperform a single attention head?
expected_snippets: jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces

expected_snippets: decoder allow each position in the decoder to attend to all positions in the decoder up to and including that position

test_cases.question: How does avoiding recurrence enable parallelization during model training?
expected_snippets: draw global dependencies between input and output

test_cases.question: How does maximum path length in self-attention compare to recurrent layers?
expected_snippets: constant O(1) number of sequentially executed operations
recurrent layer requires O(n) sequential operations

test_cases.question: What relationship exists between sequence length n and representation dimensionality d for self-attention speed?
expected_snippets: faster than recurrent layers when sequence length n is smaller than representation dimensionality d

expected_snippets: Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms
dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely

test_cases.question: What phrase is used to describe drawing global dependencies in the introduction?
expected_snippets: relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies

test_cases.question: How is the scaling factor in dot-product attention explicitly written?

expected_snippets: superior in quality while being more parallelizable

test_cases.question: Why must positional encodings be added if sequence order information is needed?
expected_snippets: model contains no recurrence and no convolution
make use of the order of the sequence

test_cases.question: What advantage does constant path length provide for experimental training efficiency?
expected_snippets: constant O(1) number of sequentially executed operations
enables high parallelization and experimental training efficiency
